name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension assistance for BPL (Below Poverty Line) disabled citizens aged 18 and above.
eligibilityCriteria: Valid disability certificate from competent authority

name: Assistive Devices for PwD (ADIP Scheme)
description: Free assistive devices such as wheelchairs, hearing aids, and prosthetics for persons with disabilities with annual income below ₹2,50,000.
eligibilityCriteria: Person with disability (PwD) with valid certificate
Not availed similar benefit in the last 3 years
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: National Handicapped Finance Development Corporation (NHFDC)
description: Concessional loans and skill training support for disabled entrepreneurs and self-employment initiatives.
notEligibleReason: Requires active business registration or startup plan
eligibilityCriteria: Person with disability (PwD) with valid certificate
Active business registration or viable business plan
Annual family income below ₹3,00,000 for concessional rates
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
